name: rust-identity-module-move
body:
source: the durable spine edges solution.component.rust-crate-identity —implemented-by→ rust.apg-rustfrontend.package_prefix_map and rust.apg-rustfrontend.crate_prefix, authored while the Rust frontend lived in the flat src/rustlib/src/main.rs.

Inconsistency: the rustlib decomposition (plan apg-cleanup, phase-04 task-6 + tasks 137–232) splits the crate into ten sibling `mod` files. The crate stays single-target — no src/lib.rs — so the Module rust.apg-rustfrontend and rust.apg-rustfrontend.main are PRESERVED, but every other unit gains a module segment in its Rust FQN. The two crate-identity functions move into the `identity` module, so their FQNs become rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.package_prefix_map and rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.crate_prefix; the old flat FQNs cease to exist and the verifying scan would have shown the authored implemented-by targets as drift.

Resolution: re-pointed the implemented-by edges here, before the verifying scan, from the flat FQNs to the already-planned rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.package_prefix_map and rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.crate_prefix (pending until the decomposition lands; the planned Implementation nodes are kept, no real code authored), and updated the component body's FQN references accordingly. The preserved Module edge solution.container.rust-frontend —implemented-by→ rust.apg-rustfrontend is untouched, as are the preserved FQNs rust.apg-rustfrontend and rust.apg-rustfrontend.main. [with coordinator]

Prose survey: `requirements.note.rust-libbin-defect` (citing the old package_prefix_map/crate_prefix) and `requirements.note.frontend-audit-reconciliation` (citing the old rust.apg-rustfrontend.load_project) both cite pre-move FQNs but are point-in-time records — the former carries the source line numbers at which the defect was observed, the latter is an audit snapshot that also cites the pylib-moved `rust.pyfrontend.detect_project_kind` — so both are left as historical, the same treatment the java/python reconciliations gave `requirements.note.identity-defect-inventory`. The component body was updated because it is a live contract description, not a change-set record.
